title: Osa Peninsula Wildlife Bingo
description: Offline field-spotting bingo for the wildlife of Corcovado and Golfo Dulce, Costa Rica.

steps: Tap a photo when you spot it. Five in a row wins.
Tap the i on a photo to see how to tell it apart.
Share the link from Actions: your friend gets card 2, with none of yours.
howto.offlineLine: Works offline once loaded. Add it to your home screen on wifi.

belowCard.lead: These share the forest and the water. Two of them never belong on a bingo cell, so they live here instead. Look, log it in your head, and give it room.

noscript: This bingo card needs JavaScript to deal the species and remember what you have spotted. It runs entirely in your browser and works offline once loaded.
